title: Comfortable, except the arms should have some type of cushion.
text: Comfortable, except the arms should have some type of cushion.. This is an ok chair.  The arms should have a little padding on them to make it more comfortable.  Being adjustable helps.  The wheels roll smoothly and the seat is comfortable.  It was easy to assemble. For the price, it's a decent chair.

product_metadata.title: Sadie Task Chair-Fixed Arm Computer Chair for Office Desk, Black (HVST402)
features: COMFORTABLE SWIVEL CHAIR: Pneumatic seat height adjustment and 360-degree swivel allows you to customize your comfort
FIXED ARM OFFICE CHAIR: Sculpted arms provide comfy all-day support for upper body and shoulders
ROLLING OFFICE CHAIR: Smooth-rolling casters and durable wheels hold up even under heavy use
BUDGET FRIENDLY: These task chairs offer excellence without expense so you can stretch your furniture dollar while working in comfort
WARRANTY & SUPPORT: Relax knowing this computer chair is backed by a limited 3-year warranty
description: The Sadie seating collection is where quality meets value. With a combination of comfort and affordability, the HVST402 is the perfect task chair for your home office, but also feels right at home in any corporate office environment. The Black fabric padded seat and back cushions and fixed arms provide outstanding comfort and support, while the 360-degree swivel motion and durable casters allow you to move anywhere in your workspace. This chair meets or exceeds industry standards for safety and durability, and is backed by a Limited 3-Year Warranty.
